name: graphicmotion
description: Home Deluxe motion-graphics pipeline: HTML compositions rendered frame by frame to MP4.

scripts.sauna-guide:upscale: python3 -I scripts/upscale_esrgan.py build/models/realesrgan-x4.onnx projects/sauna-guide/source-hq projects/sauna-guide/source/*.png projects/sauna-guide/source/*.jpg --height 2160
scripts.sauna-guide:sound: python3 -I scripts/sound_sauna.py build/sauna-guide/sound_raw.wav && ffmpeg -v error -y -i build/sauna-guide/sound_raw.wav -af loudnorm=I=-15:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 build/sauna-guide/sound.wav
scripts.sauna-guide:render: node scripts/render.js projects/sauna-guide/composition.html build/sauna-guide/master.mp4 --plates build/sauna-guide/plates --workers 3 --audio build/sauna-guide/sound.wav
scripts.sauna-guide:deliver: ffmpeg -v error -y -i build/sauna-guide/master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 19 -maxrate 14M -bufsize 28M -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -level 4.2 -g 30 -c:a copy -movflags +faststart projects/sauna-guide/output/HomeDeluxe_Sauna-Guide_MetaAd_9x16.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i projects/sauna-guide/output/HomeDeluxe_Sauna-Guide_MetaAd_9x16.mp4 -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 128k -shortest -movflags +faststart projects/sauna-guide/output/HomeDeluxe_Sauna-Guide_MetaAd_9x16_ohne-Ton.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -ss 2.9 -i build/sauna-guide/master.mp4 -frames:v 1 -q:v 2 projects/sauna-guide/output/HomeDeluxe_Sauna-Guide_Cover_9x16.jpg
